Xpo Logistics (XPO) Shareholder Credit Agricole S A Has Increased Position; Apple (AAPL) Stake Lifted by Noesis Capital Mangement Corp
May 20, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Noesis Capital Mangement Corp increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 10.33% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Noesis Capital Mangement Corp bought 1,782 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 19,026 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.22M, up from 17,244 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Noesis Capital Mangement Corp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $915.74 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.36% or $0.68 $186.31. About 16.17M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Credit Agricole S A increased its stake in Xpo Logistics Inc (XPO) by 66.61% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Credit Agricole S A bought 31,060 shares as the company’s stock rose 9.61% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 77,689 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $7.12 million, up from 46,629 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Credit Agricole S A who had been investing in Xpo Logistics Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $13.08 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.92% or $2.04 $108.4.
